digest.component_or_area: code_health metric lens and metrics infrastructure
propositions: code_health metric is language-coupled and non-portable; module_size_distribution, cap_change_events, and related metrics hardcode Python-specific paths and fabricate zeros or leak exceptions instead of failing loudly when paths are absent
rebar core must gain zero new hard dependencies; analyzer tools and stack must ship as optional [metrics] extra so core-only installs degrade to Unavailable gracefully

analyzer interface must deterministically compute loc, complexity, and duplication via scc/lizard/jscpd and reject absent/unconfigured languages with honest Unavailable reason, never fabricated zeros or leaked exceptions
per-project configuration must replace hardcoded rebar paths and module-size limits; scan root and policy thresholds become user-defined, not governance artifacts
code_health must be verified working on Python client and at least one non-Python client (Go or TypeScript) using the polyglot tool stack
